title: Elementwise left Kan representative theorem
statement: For a scheme morphism g:T→S and set sheaf F on S_et [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], each element p of that left Kan extension at an étale T-object Z has sheafified image equal to restriction along some a:Z→g*V of the adjunction-unit image of a section t in F(V), for an étale S-object V.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XN (lemma-describe-pullback), proof, paragraph beginning 'By construction of g_{i, small}^{-1}G'

proof.text: Functor.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionLeftKanExtensionUnit computes P(Z) as the costructured-arrow colimit. Types.jointly_surjective supplies an object j and section t whose cocone image is p. Set V=j.left.unop and a=j.hom.unop. The cocone map is the Kan unit followed by P.map j.hom. NatTrans.naturality_apply moves restriction past toSheafify. The composite-adjunction unit is definitionally the Kan unit followed by sheafification, so congruence closes the equality. Filteredness is not needed.
